reuse.why: Hooks the new rule into the existing pre-link guard that all six provider link handlers already call before touching any state.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once; no provider handler is edited.

placement.why: The guard in server/accounts/app.ts is the right layer, but the check is folded into ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, whose name and purpose are about duplicate links rather than the target account's state.

scope.why: One guard addition plus a parametrised test.

maintainability.why: Simple and covers every provider, though the helper now does two unrelated checks under a name that describes only one; a rename or a sibling guard would read better.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked guard shared by every link handler.

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called first by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount, linkEnableBankingAccount and linkFintegraAccount.
